content_relevant: H. No NSFW: no pornography, gore, violence, FIREARMS (senjata api) or other content unfit for the public; never sexualise characters or minors

B. No indecent or inappropriate words in any language; no promoting gambling with money or monetary assets; no provocation/drama; avoid controversial topics (religion, politics, communism, terrorism, war)
D. No false information; no scams or links that harm people's data, money or privacy
G. No promoting unverified products/services, own servers, groups, personal social accounts or stores outside the campaign objective; no outside Discord servers
E. No impersonating members/staff/bots; no sharing other people's personal data
server_conduct: A. Respect: no harassment, discrimination, intimidation, racism, mockery, doxxing, hate speech
C. No abusing access, bots or system bugs
F. No spam, no needless role pings or mentions
I. Post in the channel that fits the topic
server_rules.clip_checks: Before rendering/posting a campaign clip: mute or cut swears; no shooting, gun-shop or gore-focused moments (GTA guns visible in passing only, never the subject); no sexual frames (club dancers, underwear); no gambling; no own-account promo text burned in
